verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is an agentic AI assistant, so reaching paired devices is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence documents pairing phones or other computers, or using remote screenshots, camera, notifications or media playback. Custom agent skills and MCP compatibility are developer building blocks, not this capability, and the docs describe it as running entirely on your own computer.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant reaches beyond one machine — paired phones and computers it can use for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback
